integrity: The claimed threshold follows from the printed differential equations and is not asserted as a measured biological reproduction number. Known general food-contamination thresholds and next-generation methods are acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Standalone listeriosis-only equations (4.1) on U+C=F>0; strictly positive parameters. Equilibrium number and local disease-free threshold only, not global dynamics, full co-infection model, empirical prediction or independent audit.
title: Sharp food-mass invasion threshold in a listeriosis–food feedback model
